statement: Every remaining nonidentity cubic multiplier coordinate of a full once-punctured-torus order-three action supplies an explicit Frobenius quotient Cq semidirect C3 on which the actual representative acts identically. Its kernel is the full completion of the actual surface cover of type ((3q-1)/2,3). The full fixed subgroup of the chosen cubic section maps onto the rotation Cq, and the kernel of this map has zero mod-three first cohomology. The kernel extension has exactly three full section classes with specified representatives and normalizers. The nontrivial rotation summand of its integral 3-adic cohomology is a free Z3[C3]-module of rank q-1 under the actual cubic action.
